title: a checked project helper inside a Flow contributes its transitive effects and compiles
notes:
specification/durable-execution.mdx, 'Effect Manifest': 'A call whose callee the compiler cannot resolve MUST either be rejected inside a Flow body or force the Manifest to include the full effect set of the callee's module; it MUST NOT silently narrow the Manifest.' The (SA-2) marker records the current shape: with the VIBE4112 wall withdrawn, the Manifest is the only thing standing between a Flow body and a silently narrowed effect set, and it refuses every call to a project-declared function (VIBE4199) because neither backend derives the transitive call-graph analysis yet. This is the fail-closed arm of the MUST; the case retires into an acceptance when the Manifest learns to include the callee's effect set.

RETIRED 2026-09-05 by the implementation lane: §Flow (SA-2) requires ordinary locals, closures, calls, recursion and computed values, not Plan projections. The executable body compiler now uses checked transitive reachability and computes values before codec validation. The reference compiles and prints the declared descriptor marker. poc/src/durable/body-compiler.test.ts additionally executes the actual non-recursive corpus sources through live and replayed requests, checking their exact inputs and outputs with one worker call. The recursive fixture itself is intentionally not invoked; the same unit suite executes terminating recursion. The previous diagnostic is retained above as history, not a language restriction.

GO MARKER RETIRED 2026-09-07 after measured XPASS in the unchanged 41-case durable area. Native manifest derivation now follows checked helper and recursive implementations with a visited set. This case observes only the exact effect-manifest descriptor marker; it does not execute the Flow body and does not certify Go executable-body support. compiler/fork_manifest_closure_test.go separately checks actual transitive Action identities, requirements and source sites, including helper aliases, overloads and recursion. The authored source and expected stdout are unchanged. The September 6 Plan/body direction remains a separate decision from this shipped artifact regression.
